title: stegnogramma mollissima
intro: Stegnogramma mollissima, commonly known as the Soft-leaf Stegnogramma, is a species of fern native to the tropical regions of Asia. This fern is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the ability to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Stegnogramma mollissima include its ability to reduce fever, treat skin conditions, and provide antioxidant protection. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
